name: HINI White Park Bay
accommodation: En-suite rooms including twins with TV; groups welcome
suitableFor: Walkers, families, solo travellers and groups
beachAccess: Overlooks the National Trust beach at White Park Bay
confirmedFeatures: Self-catering kitchen, laundry, free WiFi, lounge with open fire, catering on request
overview: A Hostelling International hostel overlooking White Park Bay, with all rooms en suite and twin rooms that have TVs. Guests share a self-catering kitchen, laundry and a lounge with an open fire, and there is free secure parking. It opens to individuals from late March to late October, and only to pre-booked groups in winter.
surfTripFit: The only accommodation right above White Park Bay, so you can check the swell from the hostel and walk down to the beach.
